Landscape 2:1 canvas, exactly EIGHT separated sprites in strict invisible 4-column by 2-row grid, all inside own cell with 12% clear transparent padding, no touching. Colorful friendly animated fantasy forest adventure, tactile painterly brushwork, rounded clear appealing silhouettes, consistent warm light and cocoa outlines, orthographic SIDE VIEW. Row1 cell1: tiny plump turquoise bluebird with coral breast, head looking right, wings folded perched on tiny brown feet.
